title: Townsend Brown crash retrievals and green fireball

tellings.quote: like the late '50s, early '60s, where he would go into the field and and find stuff, flashes credentials, do crash retrievals, basically. And like he found this green fireball thing and it was losing mass and apparently that was barium titanate.

plain: Jesse Michels says that in the late 1950s and early 1960s the inventor Thomas Townsend Brown would go out into the field, flash official credentials and, in effect, recover crashed objects. According to Michels, Brown found what he calls a "green fireball thing" that was losing mass, and it was apparently made of barium titanate, a ceramic material used in electronics. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with a guest named Dave Rossi, and it would mean Brown worked on recovering unknown craft for the government.
